meta.title: 인과/선후를 나타내는 수동태 표현
meta.note: 교재 p.96~97과 정답·해설 p.70~71의 대표 Q04~Q06 원문·정답 논리를 직접 대조해 be attributed to, be followed by, be preceded by 중심의 source-aligned QA 세트로 정리함.

items.sentence: The reason for children comprehending far more if they are watching TV alone than they do with their parents, who explain new words and ideas to them, is attributed to the fact that when TV requires thought, they spend more time thinking for themselves.
items.prompt: 빈칸에 들어갈 내용으로 알맞은 것을 고르세요: watching TV ___.
items.explanation: 원인은 아이들이 스스로 생각하는 데 더 많은 시간을 쓴다는 사실로 설명되므로, 부모와 함께 볼 때보다 혼자 볼 때 더 많이 이해한다는 내용이 알맞습니다.

items.sentence: The reason for children comprehending far more if they are watching TV alone than they do with their parents, who explain new words and ideas to them, is attributed to the fact that when TV requires thought, they spend more time thinking for themselves.
items.explanation: 문장 전체의 주어는 The reason이고, 뒤의 for children ... to them은 수식어구입니다. 주절 동사구는 is attributed입니다.
items.memory: A be attributed to B = A의 원인은 B에 있다

items.sentence: Preconscious, automatic thoughts normally precede and induce emotions, which are then followed by conscious thoughts about how to deal with the situation.
items.prompt: 문장에서 가장 먼저 일어나는 것을 고르세요.
items.explanation: A is followed by B는 A 뒤에 B가 온다는 뜻입니다. 자동적 생각 → 감정 → 의식적 생각 순서입니다.
items.memory: A be followed by B = A 다음에 B

items.sentence: Organizational innovation, if it is to be successful and useful, should be preceded by participatory discussion, listening and more listening, attempts to define opposing points of view, and the seeking of a consensus.
items.explanation: A be preceded by B는 A보다 B가 먼저 온다는 뜻입니다.

items.sentence: Organizational innovation, if it is to be successful and useful, should be preceded by participatory discussion, listening and more listening, attempts to define opposing points of view, and the seeking of a consensus.
items.prompt: ‘agreement among all the people involved’라는 뜻의 단어를 입력하세요.
items.explanation: consensus는 관련된 사람들 사이의 합의, 의견 일치를 뜻합니다.
